segments.text: How would you design an API endpoint that accepts job applications?
I would make a POST endpoint, validate the fields, and save the application in the database. I have used FastAPI and Pydantic for request validation in a class project.
What if the client retries after a timeout?
I would check whether the application already exists before inserting another one. I have not implemented a formal idempotency key, but I understand it could make retries more reliable.
How would you investigate a slow database-backed endpoint?
I would look at the logs and try to find which query is slow. I know indexes can help, although I would need to inspect the query before deciding which index to add.
How do you test this workflow?

I would test valid and invalid requests and check that the database contains the expected application. I have written a few endpoint tests but have not tested background jobs or file uploads in that project.
What security risks would you review?

I would make sure users are logged in and validate uploaded files. I am not sure yet how I would prevent one applicant from accessing another person's application, so I would want to review the authorization checks carefully.
